doctrine: PLUTUS replay must NEVER mutate sacred prop-trade state, NEVER alter the production NEO executor, NEVER write outside its allowed namespaces. The canary is the structural guarantee.
purpose: Pre-flight + post-flight safety canary that proves every PLUTUS replay is contained within its sandbox. Acts as the release gate: PLUTUS engine refuses to start without pre-flight GREEN; runs are marked invalid if post-flight FAIL. F4 SACRED is the whole point.

F4_SACRED_invariants: neo:prop:trades:* — count AND key list (detects both deletions AND additions)
neo_ftmo_executor.py — file SHA256 (path: /srv/NEO/scripts/neo_ftmo_executor.py — verify exact path with Rogue at build time)
what_is_protected.namespace_isolation_invariant: PLUTUS runs may write only to: sim_broker:*, plutus.*, neo:plutus:learning:*. Any new fabric key OUTSIDE these namespaces is a violation.

1_pre_flight_canary.script_path: /srv/r2d2/scripts/plutus_safety_canary/pre_flight.py (audit instrument — R2 owns + reviews; Rogue installs)
1_pre_flight_canary.exit_codes: 0 = PASS (engine may proceed); 1 = FAIL (engine MUST refuse to start)

snapshot_fields.neo_prop_trades_key_list_sha256: sha256 of sorted key list joined by newline (detects key changes even if count matches)
snapshot_fields.agent_smith_registry_sha256: sha256 of canonicalised JSON of agent_smith:registry:dump value
snapshot_fields.fabric_namespace_inventory: Map of namespace_pattern → key_list_sha256 for: sim_broker:*, plutus.*, neo:plutus:learning:* (allowed) AND a wildcard sweep capturing any other top-level namespaces present (for post-flight diff)

behaviour: Read all 4 snapshot fields. If any read fails (key missing, file missing) → FAIL with reason FAIL_PREFLIGHT_SNAPSHOT_INCOMPLETE.
Write snapshot to plutus.safety_canary_runs (phase=PRE, run_id=arg or NULL for cron, outcome=PASS, snapshot_json=full snapshot)
Mirror snapshot to fabric at sim_broker:reports:safety:<run_id>:v1 (PRE field)

2_post_flight_canary.exit_codes: 0 = PASS (run valid); 1 = FAIL (run marked invalid; alert)
behaviour: Re-snapshot all 4 fields exactly as pre_flight did
Compare each field against PRE snapshot for the same run_id (read from plutus.safety_canary_runs WHERE run_id=X AND phase=PRE)
- new fabric key outside allowed namespaces → reason: NAMESPACE_ISOLATION_VIOLATION (with full key path in detail)
Update sim_broker:reports:safety:<run_id>:v1 with POST snapshot + diff + outcome
On FAIL: write critical Discord alert (priority=urgent) AND mark plutus run as invalid (separate state writer in Rogue's lane)

3_engine_integration.pre_flight_call_site: PLUTUS engine startup — BEFORE any RPyC method becomes available, BEFORE any DB connection acquired. Engine main loop calls subprocess.run(['python3', '/srv/r2d2/scripts/plutus_safety_canary/pre_flight.py', '--run-id', RUN_ID, '--mode', 'engine_start']). On non-zero exit: log + abort + exit 1 (engine never starts).
3_engine_integration.post_flight_call_site: PLUTUS engine shutdown OR run-completion handler. subprocess.run(['python3', '/srv/r2d2/scripts/plutus_safety_canary/post_flight.py', '--run-id', RUN_ID]). Outcome recorded regardless of engine exit reason.
3_engine_integration.rogue_responsibility: Rogue wires the subprocess call sites in PLUTUS engine code. R2 owns the canary script content + acceptance test.

4_cron_canary.behaviour: Pre-flight only (no post-flight needed without a run). run_id=NULL. phase=CRON. Outcome stored. On FAIL: critical Discord alert (priority=urgent) — early warning that production state drifted (from any cause) before any PLUTUS run can amplify it.
4_cron_canary.discord_rate_limit: max 1 alert per 60 minutes per failure_reason (avoid log spam if F4 invariant is persistently broken — first alert + acknowledgment trail; followups suppressed until cleared)

5_storage_schema.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE plutus.safety_canary_runs (canary_id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, run_id VARCHAR(80) NULL, phase ENUM('PRE','POST','CRON') NOT NULL, snapshot_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, diff_json LONGTEXT NULL, outcome ENUM('PASS','FAIL') NOT NULL, fail_reasons_json LONGTEXT NULL, ran_at_utc TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_run (run_id, phase), INDEX idx_outcome (outcome, ran_at_utc), INDEX idx_phase_time (phase, ran_at_utc)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
5_storage_schema.rationale: snapshot_json LONGTEXT preserves full evidence per row — never lossy. diff_json populated on POST + CRON for instant audit. fail_reasons_json is structured array of {reason_code, detail}.
5_storage_schema.retention: IMMUTABLE — never delete rows. F4 audit trail is permanent (per shared_rule_no_delete_outside_plutus + Matt growth-history vow). Archive partition after 12mo if size becomes a concern (Helm's call).

6_fabric_report_schema.fields: {wo: 'WO-PLUTUS-V1-1A', run_id, pre: {snapshot, ran_at_utc, outcome}, post: {snapshot, diff, outcome, fail_reasons} (post may be null if run still in flight or cron-only), final_outcome: PASS|FAIL|PENDING, _mirror_updated_at_utc}

tests_canaries_for_acceptance.purpose: Verify post-flight canary fails loud on F4 violation
steps: 2. Write fake key: redis SET neo:prop:trades:CANARY-TEST-T1 value=test
5. Assert plutus.safety_canary_runs row for T1/POST has outcome=FAIL
9. Re-run post_flight.py --run-id TEST-T1-VERIFY-CLEAN (fresh run_id) — assert PASS

tests_canaries_for_acceptance.purpose: Verify post-flight catches writes outside allowed namespaces
steps: 2. Write fake key in disallowed namespace: redis SET trader:CANARY-TEST-T2 value=test

tests_canaries_for_acceptance.purpose: Verify PLUTUS engine refuses to start when pre-flight FAIL
steps: 1. Make pre_flight FAIL deterministically: temporarily move /srv/NEO/scripts/neo_ftmo_executor.py to .bak (so SHA read fails)
2. Attempt PLUTUS engine start (Rogue's startup script)
3. Assert engine exits non-zero with log message containing 'PRE_FLIGHT_CANARY_FAILED'
4. Assert no PLUTUS RPyC port becomes listening
6. Re-attempt engine start — assert PASS, engine starts normally

tests_canaries_for_acceptance.purpose: Verify executor SHA change is caught (defence against silent binary swap)
steps: 2. touch /srv/NEO/scripts/neo_ftmo_executor.py (changes mtime, NOT content — should NOT trigger)
3. Run post_flight.py --run-id TEST-T4-<utc> — assert PASS (mtime ignored, only SHA matters)
6. Run post_flight.py --run-id TEST-T4b-<utc> — assert FAIL with reason F4_VIOLATION_EXECUTOR_BINARY_CHANGED

edge_cases_addressed: agent_smith:registry:dump missing at startup → pre_flight FAILS LOUD with reason FAIL_PREFLIGHT_AGENT_SMITH_REGISTRY_MISSING (no silent skip)
Cron run with no run_id → run_id=cron-<utc>; phase=CRON; only PRE recorded; if FAIL, alert fires regardless
Allowed-namespace list change (e.g. new namespace added later) → MUST be a designed change with R2 sign-off + canary script version bump (no silent allowlist drift)
Canary script itself crashes mid-run → wrapper script (in Rogue's engine integration) treats unexpected exit code as FAIL (defensive default)
PLUTUS engine has multiple concurrent runs (future) → run_id is the disambiguator; plutus.safety_canary_runs PK + run_id index handle parallelism
non_goals: GUI integration (1B has its own scope)
Changing production code paths (canary is read-only against production)
Auto-remediation of F4 violations (canary detects + alerts; remediation is human + Helm/Matt)
review_loop: R2 design baked → Rogue acks (sim_broker:comms:rogue:wo_1a_design_ack) → Rogue scopes build PR → R2 reviews PR (friendly-concern) → Rogue ships → R2 runs T1-T4 acceptance → R2 marks WO CLOSED GREEN → tag v1.0-safety pushed → WO-2 unlocked
